title: Mega Man 4
intro: A route through the Robot Masters, the utility items worth collecting, and the final stages. Read the introduction for the controls and systems specific to this game.
facts: Weapons, utility items and final stages
primer: Mega Man 4 adds charged Buster shots. Hold Fire until fully charged, then release. Slide remains Down + Jump. Rush Coil is available immediately.
E-Tanks are one-use full-health refills. Open the weapon menu before the next hit could kill you. They are not refillable Sub Tanks.

Balloon and Wire are optional hidden mobility tools. You can revisit stages to collect them. Original passwords do not preserve E-Tanks or progress through the two fortresses; use the collection save feature when stopping.
routeIntro: Toad is a manageable charged-Buster start. Follow Rain Flush to Bright and Flash Stopper to Pharaoh; continue around the weakness chain.

returnIntro: Collect the listed utility items before entering the fortress. Ordinary energy, lives and tanks are consumable supplies, not X-style permanent health upgrades.
completionText: Clear all Robot Masters, check the utility items listed above, and refill the weapons needed for the final stages.

sections.title: Cossack and Wily fortresses
paragraphs: Cossack: target the drill boss’s small gem with Ring Boomerang. Dust Crusher reaches the moving room’s top gem. Drill Bomb or charged Pharaoh Shot works on the wall climbers. Slide beneath Cossack’s claw.
Wily: use charged Buster or Ring Boomerang on the giant Met, then Ring Boomerang on the green target of the bomb-dropping machine.
Wily Machine: use Buster or Dust Crusher on the mouth, then detonate Drill Bomb just beside the green cockpit target by pressing Fire again.
Wily Capsule: use charged Pharaoh Shot and dodge toward open ground after noting where Wily appears. Keep Pharaoh Shot energy for this fight.

sections.title: Useful tips
paragraphs: Flash Stopper pauses many dangerous enemies while still allowing Buster fire. Balloon is useful for high pickups but its platforms rise and expire.
Skull Man’s stage has accessible E-Tanks for restocking before committing to both fortresses.
